thread:
maria: FYI DSAR (EU) just landed asking for deletion of all user-provided data tied to user-id 0xA3F. Problem: Legal placed a temporary litigation hold earlier today for the same account. Need clarification on retention exception scope and KMS snapshot handling. @akshay @oliver :eyes:
akshay: can you paste the DSAR? also which pipelines/storage? embeddings, text logs, telemetry?
maria: link: https://priv.redwood/legal/dsar/ID-2024-411
maria: Main things: user messages + embeddings + eval traces. Requesting full erasure across hosted and dedicated copies.
oliver: if legal hold is active we should not delete. but we need to confirm whether hold is scoped to investigational data only or full account. tagging @sara-legal
sara-legal: confirmed hold id LH-2024-77 - scope 'investigation:incident-345' only. DSAR targets user account; not automatically blocked unless evidence ties to incident. need engineering to confirm whether any snapshots/forensics references this user.
akshay: ok. tech question: our KMS key rotation & snapshot retention mean EBS/GCS snapshots might still contain encrypted blobs. Deleting DB rows is not enough. We need to run embargoed snapshot purge and call KMS: schedule key-destruct? we usually don't destroy keys. /cc @jen-ops
jen-ops: ops here. Snapshot purge requires a change in retention-exception flow. currently we only purge object storage older than TTL unless retention exception. If we proceed we need legal sign-off and a change to the hold flag. Also need to record audit log entries: who authorized purge + runbook id.
sec-bot: INCIDENT BOT: legal hold LH-2024-77 created by sara-legal at 2024-11-03T15:02:33Z
maria: proposed plan: 1) engineering to scan for any artifacts referencing user id across S3, backups, snapshots, DB exports. 2) produce evidence manifest and confirm none are tied to LH-2024-77. 3) legal to sign removal of hold or provide redaction scope. 4) ops to run purge and KMS re-wrap if needed. 5) record audit logs + create retention exception ticket.
akshay: follow-ups: RBAC - need a scoped service account `dsar-eraser@redwood` with kms: decrypt/list, storage: delete, and audit-only role for write. Will submit infra PR. Also need a pre-deletion checkpoint that generates an evidence bundle (sha256 list) and push to legal-silo.
oliver: quick check commands for evidence scan:
oliver: ```bash
# list snapshots containing 'user-0xA3F'
gsutil ls -r gs://redwood-backups/** | xargs -I{} grep -l "0xA3F" {}
# naive, might be slow. use datalake indexer instead
``` 
jen-ops: copy that. ops will add a step to snapshot-ttl workflow to flag deletions that require manual confirmation when a legal hold exists. Will also ensure cloud audit logs are exported to secure bucket (audit-log-ark) before purge.
sara-legal: legal OK to proceed with scan. If scan shows nothing tied to LH-2024-77, I can lift the hold. Please include a signed manifest with hashes and timestamps.
maria: timeline: aim to finish scans + manifest by EOD tomorrow. akshay to open infra PR for service account and RBAC change; jen to prepare ops playbook; oliver to run scan. I'll coordinate with legal.
akshay: opening PR now: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pull/5247 - adds dsar-eraser SA + iam roles. Will set reviewers @oliver @jen-ops
oliver: running scan now. will post summary + top-level hits. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all. tagging this thread for audit: we need to log decision path and signoffs.
sec-bot: AUDIT: retention-exception ticket created RE-2024-922 by maria
oliver: scan done: found 2 small eval traces in s3://private-evals/2024/03/trace-786.json and a DB export row in archived_exports/2023-12-01.tar.gz referencing 0xA3F. None tied to LH-2024-77 per quick check. attaching evidence manifest.
maria: uploading manifest to legal vault https://vault.redwood/legal/manifests/RE-2024-922-manifest.json
sara-legal: I've reviewed manifest and will lift LH-2024-77 for this account at 2024-11-04T10:12Z. Legal sign-off: Sara L. (signed)
jen-ops: proceeding with purge window 2024-11-04T11:00Z - will snapshot audit logs first and then purge blobs. ops will post runbook link after
akshay: note: do not destroy KMS keys. we'll mark objects deleted and revoke access and rotate wrapping key if required. adding audit entries.
maria: closing loop: after purge, please post deletion confirmation (hashes + deletion-operation ids). also add record to DSAR tracker.
jen-ops: done: runbook https://runbooks.redwood/purge/RE-2024-922 - purge completed 2024-11-04T11:33Z. Deleted objects: 3, DB rows: 1. Audit log: gs://audit-log-ark/RE-2024-922/audit.json
sec-bot: AUDIT: deletion completed for RE-2024-922 by jen-ops at 2024-11-04T11:33:10Z
maria: thanks everyone. leaving note for follow-up: pre-authorize dsar-eraser in staging and add automatic evidence-bundling in the DSAR runbook.
akshay: PR merged. iam policy: roles/storage.objectAdmin on dsar-eraser, kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt. policy change logged in PR.
oliver: closing thread. :wave:
